## Bug Report

The "Check" button on the storefront ZIP code widget has a loading spinner that doesn't look good — the button is too narrow so the loader gets clipped or looks cramped. The user wants to increase the button width slightly so the loader looks better, both in the admin panel live preview AND on the actual storefront.

## Your Task

1. Read the widget liquid file FULLY at `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`
2. Read the widget admin page at `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` to find the live preview section
3. Find the Check button width/min-width styles in BOTH files
4. Increase the button width slightly (e.g. from whatever it currently is to something a bit wider so the loading spinner has room to display properly)
5. Make sure the change applies to ALL widget positions (inline, floating, popup)
6. Run `npm run typecheck` to verify zero TypeScript errors

## Fix Requirements
- Increase button min-width so the loading spinner looks good inside it
- Apply the fix in BOTH the liquid widget file AND the admin preview
- Make the smallest change that fixes the issue — only change button width/min-width
- Do NOT refactor or change anything else

## Report Format
After fixing, provide:
```
## Bug Fix Report
**Root cause**: [1 sentence]
**Files changed**: [file:line_range for each]
**Fix applied**: [what changed and why]
**Verification**: typecheck result
```

content.text: Let me read both files fully before making any changes.

Now I have a clear picture of both files. Let me locate the exact button style in the liquid file and the admin preview.

In the liquid file (line 410), the `.zcc-btn` CSS has `padding:12px 24px` but no `min-width`. In the admin preview `buildWidgetCss` function (line 348), same pattern — `padding:12px 24px` with no `min-width`.

The loading state hides the label (`labelEl.style.display = 'none'`) and replaces the icon with the spinner, leaving only the spinner inside the button. Without a `min-width`, the button collapses to whatever the spinner (18px) plus padding takes up — causing the clipped/cramped look.

The fix is to add `min-width:110px` to `.zcc-btn` in both files.

## Bug Fix Report

**Root cause**: The `.zcc-btn` had no `min-width` set, so when the loading state hid the text label and replaced the icon with the 18px spinner, the button shrank to just the spinner's width plus padding, clipping it visually.

**Files changed**:
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` — line 410
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.widget.tsx` — line 348

**Fix applied**: Added `min-width:110px` to the `.zcc-btn` CSS rule in `buildWidgetCss` in both files. This gives the button a stable minimum width so the spinner always has comfortable room to display centered inside it, regardless of how short the button text is. The fix covers all three widget positions (inline, floating, popup) because they all share the same `.zcc-btn` class produced by `buildWidgetCss`.

**Verification**: `npm run typecheck` completed with zero errors.
